# Piyush's Bakery

> Freshly baked cakes, pastries, breads, cookies, and custom bakery products.

## About

Piyush's Bakery is a bakery website showcasing freshly prepared bakery products and custom orders.

## Products

The bakery offers cakes, pastries, breads, cookies, and other freshly baked products.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://bakrey.vercel.app/
- Order online: https://bakrey.vercel.app/order
- Pre-order: https://bakrey.vercel.app/pre-order
- Delivery policy: https://bakrey.vercel.app/delivery-policy
- Privacy policy: https://bakrey.vercel.app/privacy-policy
- Terms and conditions: https://bakrey.vercel.app/terms
- Refund and cancellation policy: https://bakrey.vercel.app/refund-policy

## Contact

For current product availability, prices, custom orders, and other inquiries, use the contact details on the website or the pre-order page.

## Content Policy

Product availability, prices, and business information may change. The website is the authoritative source for current information.
